s: Christ is the image of the invisible God, the head of the body, the Church.
In Christ the fullness of God dwells. Do not be led astray by human traditions.
Seek the things above. Put on love. Rules for the Christian household.

2: In older English “meat” meant any food, not only flesh.
3: The bowels were thought of as the seat of feeling. Here: the heart, deep compassion.
4: “Solicitous” here means caring, concerned for others.
